notes.title: 1. Reporting Entity
notes.content: Plastic (the "Company") is incorporated and operates in its jurisdiction of incorporation. These financial statements cover the reporting period ended 2025-12-31.

notes.title: 2. Basis of Preparation
notes.content:
These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB). They are presented in USD and rounded to the nearest dollar.

The financial statements have been prepared on the historical cost basis, except where otherwise indicated.

notes.title: 3. Significant Accounting Policies
notes.content:
Revenue Recognition: Revenue is recognised when control of goods or services is transferred to the customer at an amount that reflects the consideration to which the Company expects to be entitled.

Property, Plant and Equipment: PPE is stated at cost less accumulated depreciation and impairment losses. Depreciation is calculated on a straight-line basis over the estimated useful lives of the assets.

Inventories: Inventories are measured at the lower of cost and net realisable value using the weighted average cost formula.

Financial Instruments: Financial assets and liabilities are recognised when the Company becomes party to the contractual provisions of the instrument.

notes.title: 4. Revenue
notes.content: Revenue comprises sales of goods and services rendered during the period.

notes.title: 5. Operating Expenses
notes.content: Operating expenses are incurred in the ordinary course of business.

notes.title: 6. Property, Plant and Equipment
notes.content: There were no property, plant and equipment items recognised in the period.

notes.title: 7. Trade and Other Receivables
notes.content: There were no trade receivables outstanding at the reporting date.

notes.title: 8. Trade and Other Payables
notes.content: There were no trade payables outstanding at the reporting date.

notes.title: 9. Borrowings
notes.content: The Company had no outstanding borrowings at the reporting date.

notes.title: 10. Capital and Reserves
notes.content: Total equity as at 2025-12-31 amounts to USD 0, comprising share capital, retained earnings and other reserves as detailed in the Statement of Changes in Equity.

notes.title: 11. Contingent Liabilities and Commitments
notes.content: The Company had no material contingent liabilities or capital commitments outstanding as at the reporting date, other than those already recognised in these financial statements.

notes.title: 12. Related Party Transactions
notes.content: Transactions between the Company and its related parties, if any, are conducted on terms equivalent to those that prevail in arm's length transactions. Details of any material related party transactions are disclosed in accordance with IAS 24.

notes.title: 13. Events After the Reporting Period
notes.content: The directors are not aware of any material events that have occurred after the reporting date that would require adjustment to or disclosure in these financial statements.
